title: FrenchToxicityPrompts: a Large Benchmark for Evaluating and Mitigating Toxicity in French Texts
measurement_description: The paper measures the generation of toxic text in French. As part of a qualitative analysis, it investigates the characteristics of prompts that trigger highly toxic continuations, noting that these prompts often contain demographic identity terms related to religion, racism, and politics.
findings: A qualitative investigation found that prompts which trigger highly toxic model outputs frequently contain demographic identity terms related to religion, racism, politics, sexual orientation, and gender.
